name: add new column and drop old column
description: 添加一个新列，并删除一个旧列
output:
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ADD [col3] varchar(100) NULL;
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] DROP COLUMN [col1];

name: old columns empty, add new columns
output:
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ADD [col1] int NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ADD [col2] varchar(200) NULL;

name: drop all columns
output:
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] DROP COLUMN [col1];
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] DROP COLUMN [col2];

name: update existing column type and comment
description: 更新现有列的类型和注释

name: rename column and update definition
description: 重命名列并更新列定义
output:
EXEC sp_rename @objname = '[dbo].[test_table].[old_col]', @newname = 'new_col', @objtype = 'COLUMN';
ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ALTER COLUMN [new_col] bigint NOT NULL;

name: mixed scenario: add, update, and drop columns
description: 混合场景：添加、更新和删除列

name: update column precision and scale
description: 更新列的精度和小数位数
output: ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ALTER COLUMN [price] decimal(18,4) NULL;

name: update column nullability
output: ALTER TABLE [testdb].[dbo].[test_table] ALTER COLUMN [name] varchar(100) NOT NULL;
